title: Understanding Latency, Colocation, and Infrastructure in HFT
subtitle: How speed is engineered, bought, and regulated in high frequency trading
description: A ground-up look at the infrastructure layer of high frequency trading: what latency actually costs, why firms pay for colocation at NSE and BSE, how SEBI regulates fair access, and the network and hardware choices that separate microseconds from milliseconds.
whatYouLearn: How tick-to-trade latency is measured and where the time actually goes
Why colocation at NSE and BSE exists and how SEBI regulates fair access to it
How fiber, microwave, and FPGA hardware choices trade off cost against speed
How clock synchronization and timestamp audit rules work in Indian markets
